title: 大闹天宫
subtitle: 云海里的一场追逐游戏
origin: 《西游记》第五至七回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 遇到不公平要勇敢说出来，也要尊重约定；本领越大，责任也越大。
moral.en: Speak up when something feels unfair, but respect agreements too. Greater ability brings greater responsibility.

pages.zh: 离开蟠桃园后，悟空仍觉得心里不服气，竟又闯进天宫宴会。
pages.en: After leaving the Peach Garden, Wukong still felt upset and barged into the heavenly banquet.
pages.prompt: Wukong enters a heavenly banquet hall through open doors, restless and defiant, light peach petals in air, table of fruit and pastries, no other pilgrims. [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]]

pages.zh: 仙人们请他停下，他却仗着本领大，把规矩忘在了脑后。
pages.en: The immortals asked him to stop, but he relied on his powers and forgot the rules.
pages.prompt: Wukong stands beside heavenly horses as gentle celestial attendants ask him to stop; he feels upset, no aggressive violence. [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]]

pages.zh: 悟空想起自己在花果山喊过：“我是齐天大圣！”可响亮的称号，不能代替对别人的尊重。
pages.en: Wukong remembered proclaiming on Flower-Fruit Mountain, “I am the Great Sage Equal to Heaven!” But a grand title could not replace respect for others.
pages.prompt: Wukong recalls proclaiming himself Great Sage Equal to Heaven on Flower Fruit Mountain, standing beside a blank red flag and monkey friends, thoughtful proud expression. [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]]

pages.zh: 天宫派人来劝阻。悟空不肯听，腾起云头，想用变化躲开大家。
pages.en: Heaven sent helpers to stop him. Wukong would not listen and tried to escape by changing shape.
pages.prompt: Wukong faces the kind Jade Emperor in white gold robes turquoise ceremonial crown, emperor gently asks him to listen, golden palace. [[WUKONG_STAFF_NO_HEADBAND]]

pages.zh: 蟠桃熟了，悟空没问一声就尝了一个；听说宴会没请他，又悄悄跑去看看。
pages.en: When the peaches ripened, Wukong tasted one without asking. Then he heard he was not invited to the feast and quietly went to see it for himself.

pages.zh: 悟空一时贪玩，吃了点心，碰乱了彩带。天兵举着仪仗旗，请他停下来。
pages.en: Wukong got carried away, sampled some treats, and tangled the ribbons. The heavenly attendants raised their ceremonial banners and asked him to stop.

pages.zh: 悟空变成小鸟、云朵和小桃子，在云海里绕来绕去，大家追成一场热闹游戏。
pages.en: Wukong turned into a bird, a cloud, and a tiny peach, darting through the sky until the chase felt like a lively game.

pages.zh: 追逐终于停下，悟空向玉帝低下了头。可天宫风波还未结束，他将面对如来的考验。
pages.en: The chase stopped, and Wukong bowed his head before the Jade Emperor. But the turmoil was not over: the Buddha’s challenge still awaited him.
